posts.title: Right, then left
posts.description: The e-Título app checked my face and my GPS to excuse me from voting in Brazil's runoff, but it couldn't let me vote. More than 30 million Brazilians didn't vote either, in a race decided by 4 million. So, I looked into how Estonia votes online and naively built a prototype for voting on the plan instead of the person.

posts.title: Haiku and Haibun
posts.description: I asked a few folks who actually know what they’re doing with writing, and one of them told me my writing looks a bit like haibun (a Japanese form that mixes short prose with haiku, made famous by Bashō’s travel journals). I was so excited about that diagnosis (a diagnosis??? Like it’s a condition), especially…
